description: Java class implementing CoapTransportAdaptor for handling CoAP protocol messages, converting between protobuf messages and CoAP responses, and integrating with Thingsboard transport system.

classes.name: ProtoCoapAdaptor
classes.description: Java class implementing CoapTransportAdaptor for handling CoAP messages and protobuf conversions.

methods.name: convertToPostTelemetry
methods.description: Converts incoming CoAP request to PostTelemetry protobuf message using protobuf descriptor and JSON conversion.

methods.name: convertToPostAttributes
methods.description: Converts incoming CoAP request to PostAttribute protobuf message.

methods.name: convertToGetAttributes
methods.description: Creates a GetAttributeRequest protobuf message from CoAP request.

methods.name: convertToDeviceRpcResponse
methods.description: Converts CoAP request to ToDeviceRpcResponse protobuf message, extracting request ID and payload.

methods.name: convertToServerRpcRequest
methods.description: Converts CoAP request payload to ServerRpcRequest protobuf message.

methods.name: convertToClaimDevice
methods.description: Creates ClaimDevice protobuf message from session info and request payload.

methods.name: convertToProvisionRequestMsg
methods.description: Converts request payload to ProvisionDeviceRequest protobuf message.

methods.name: convertToPublish (ToServerRpcResponseMsg)
methods.description: Wraps ToServerRpcResponseMsg into CoAP response with content.

methods.name: convertToPublish (GetAttributeResponseMsg)
methods.description: Creates CoAP response from GetAttributeResponseMsg, handling shared state and errors.

methods.name: getObserveNotification
methods.description: Creates a CoAP response with payload for notifications.

methods.name: getContentFormat
methods.description: Returns the content format for CoAP messages (application/octet-stream).
